description.value:
You study and brew medicine to treat patients. You become an expert in Medicine, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Serum Crafting] feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You can use Medicine instead of Crafting to Craft medical consumables.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can make four medical consumables with an item level up to your level. You must know each item's formula. An item created this way is a temporary item and loses its potency the next time you make your daily preparations if you haven't already used it.
